description: Real data: ENCODE H3K27ac ChIP-seq in primary human CD8-positive alpha-beta T cells (ENCSR835OJV, Bernstein lab; file ENCFF283CAQ, replicated peaks, GRCh38), the 1000 strongest peaks. H3K27ac marks active promoters and enhancers, so these regions should be enriched for T-cell identity genes and bound by T-cell lineage factors (RUNX, ETS, TCF/LEF, T-bet/Eomes). Which pathways and regulators are active in resting human CD8 T cells?
condition: primary human blood CD8 T cells, resting
